Original Requirements:
visulize game with a snake eating the balls

IMPORTANT: You must create a comprehensive README.md file explaining how to run and test the project.
Product Goals: Create a visually appealing and engaging snake game.
Ensure smooth gameplay and responsive controls.
Provide clear instructions and testing guidelines in the README.md file.
User Stories: As a player, I want to control the snake's movement with arrow keys.
As a player, I want to see the snake grow longer when it eats a ball.
As a player, I want the game to end when the snake collides with the wall or itself.
As a developer, I want clear instructions on how to run the game.
As a tester, I want clear instructions on how to test the game's functionality.
Competitive Analysis: Classic Snake Game: Simple graphics, basic functionality.
Snake.io: Multiplayer online snake game with power-ups.
Google Snake Game: Accessible and easy to play, but lacks advanced features.
Slither.io: Similar to Snake.io, focuses on multiplayer competition.
Nibbles (DOS Game): A classic snake game with increasing difficulty.

Collision detection with the walls and itself is crucial for game over conditions.
